title: Running sum
prompt: Return the running prefix sums of `nums`: out[i] = nums[0] + ... + nums[i].

title: Maximum subarray
prompt: Return the largest sum of any contiguous non-empty subarray of `nums` (Kadane).

title: Move zeroes
prompt: Move all zeroes in `nums` to the end while keeping the order of non-zero elements. Return the list.
solution:
def move_zeroes(nums):
    return [x for x in nums if x != 0] + [0] * nums.count(0)

title: Product except self
prompt: Return an array where out[i] is the product of every element except nums[i]. No division.

title: Rotate array

title: Reverse string
prompt: Return string `s` reversed. Use two pointers conceptually; do not just call reversed on the whole string trivially.
solution:
def reverse_string(s):
    return s[::-1]

title: Valid palindrome
prompt: Return True if `s` is a palindrome considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring case.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

title: Valid anagram
prompt: Return True if `t` is an anagram of `s`.
solution:
def is_anagram(s, t):
    return sorted(s) == sorted(t)

title: Contains duplicate
prompt: Return True if any value appears at least twice in `nums`.
solution:
def contains_duplicate(nums):
    return len(set(nums)) != len(nums)

title: Max window sum
prompt: Return the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of length exactly `k`.
solution:
def max_window_sum(nums, k):
    cur = sum(nums[:k])
    best = cur
    for i in range(k, len(nums)):
        cur += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
        best = max(best, cur)
    return best
